title: Crucible config
description: Configuration for crucible-ai, read from crucible.config.json or crucible.config.jsonc in the directory Jest runs from. Never put an API key in this file.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this JSON Schema, for editor hints. Ignored by Crucible.

provider.description: The judge provider to call. "openai-compatible" also needs "baseUrl".

model.description: The provider's model id for the judge, passed through as given. Recommended on OpenRouter: "deepseek/deepseek-v4-flash-0731".

baseUrl.description: API root of an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (openai-compatible only); judge calls go to <baseUrl>/chat/completions. http or https, without credentials, query or fragment.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the judge's API key. Never the key itself.

meta.description: Extra request-body fields sent with every judge request, unmodified (for example { "reasoning": { "effort": "low" } }). Default: none. Never put a secret here.

verbosity.description: Output detail: "default", "full" (every run in failure reports) or "debug" (also a trace of each judge call). CRUCIBLE_VERBOSE overrides it.

excerptChars.description: Length of the response excerpt in failure reports, in characters.

testDefaults.description: Project-wide defaults for every crucible.it(). Options declared on a test win.

runs.description: How many times each test body runs, concurrently. Each run calls your system and the judge.

threshold.description: Fraction of runs that must pass, greater than 0 and at most 1. The test needs ceil(threshold × runs) passing runs.

inferenceTimeout.description: Time limit for each judge request, in milliseconds.

testTimeout.description: Time limit for the whole test, in milliseconds. Default: 30000 + 1000 × (runs − 1), so 39000 for 10 runs; a value set here no longer grows with runs.
